name: What is the process for installing a porch lift or ramp?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing a porch lift or ramp?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation and site assessment. Our team will evaluate your porch, measure the available space, discuss your accessibility needs, and review potential solutions. Following this, a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and cost will be provided. Once approved, necessary permits are secured. Installation involves preparing the site, constructing or assembling the chosen modification (ramp or lift), ensuring it meets safety standards, and conducting a final inspection. We aim for efficient and minimally disruptive installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The installation process involves consultation, site assessment, proposal, permit acquisition, installation, and final inspection to ensure safety and functionality.
